description:
Stop caring what people think.

Their opinions don’t pay your bills.
They don’t build your dreams.
They don’t wake up early and do the reps for you.

And the truth? Most people are too busy worrying about what everyone else thinks of them to spend that much time judging you.

If you keep living for approval, you’ll always shrink to fit someone else’s comfort zone.

Build anyway.
Post anyway.
Launch anyway.
Speak anyway.

Because the only opinion that actually changes your life…
is the one you have about yourself.
transcript: People don't care as much about what you do as you think they do. Everybody cares about themselves. And so many times we're worrying if we fail. We're worrying if it doesn't go good. We're worrying if we embarrass ourselves. In front of who? The most embarrassing thing we could ever do is get to the end of your life and realize you played small. You left all of it on the table and you don't get another shot. That's what could be embarrassing. That's more scary to me than anything else. Get into the end and realize you freaking missed it.
